#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Differential expression analysis of RNA-seq data: KL vs WL."""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
counts_df = pd.read_csv("inputs/count.csv", index_col=0)

print("Count matrix shape:", counts_df.shape)
print("Columns:", list(counts_df.columns))
print("First few rows:")
print(counts_df.head())

# ── Full analysis: KL1-3 vs WL1-3 ─────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n" + "="*70)
print("FULL ANALYSIS: KL1-3 vs WL1-3")
print("="*70)

counts_full = counts_df.copy()
metadata_full = pd.DataFrame({
    "condition": ["KL", "KL", "KL", "WL", "WL", "WL"]
}, index=["KL1", "KL2", "KL3", "WL1", "WL2", "WL3"])

# Filter very lowly expressed genes first (optional but speeds things up)
# Keep genes with at least 10 counts total across all samples
# counts_full = counts_full[counts_full.sum(axis=1) >= 10]

dds_full = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_full,
    metadata=metadata_full,
    design="~condition",
)
dds_full.deseq2()

# Statistical testing with LFC shrinkage
stat_full = DeseqStats(dds_full, contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"])
stat_full.summary()

# Apply LFC shrinkage
stat_full.lfc_shrink(coeff="condition_KL_vs_WL")

res_full = stat_full.results_df
print("\nResults columns:", list(res_full.columns))
print(f"Total genes tested: {len(res_full)}")

# Filter
sig_full = res_full[
    (res_full["padj"] < 0.05) &
    (res_full["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
    (res_full["baseMean"] > 10)
]
n_full = len(sig_full)
print(f"\nSignificant DEGs (p<0.05, |log2FC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_full}")
print(f"  Upregulated (KL > WL): {(sig_full['log2FoldChange'] > 0).sum()}")
print(f"  Downregulated (KL < WL): {(sig_full['log2FoldChange'] < 0).sum()}")

# ── Subset analysis: KL1-2 vs WL1-2 (excluding third replicates) ──────────
print("\n" + "="*70)
print("SUBSET ANALYSIS: KL1-2 vs WL1-2 (excluding KL3, WL3)")
print("="*70)

samples_subset = ["KL1", "KL2", "WL1", "WL2"]
counts_subset = counts_df[samples_subset].copy()

metadata_subset = pd.DataFrame({
    "condition": ["KL", "KL", "WL", "WL"]
}, index=samples_subset)

dds_subset = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_subset,
    metadata=metadata_subset,
    design="~condition",
)
dds_subset.deseq2()

stat_subset = DeseqStats(dds_subset, contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"])
stat_subset.summary()
stat_subset.lfc_shrink(coeff="condition_KL_vs_WL")

res_subset = stat_subset.results_df
print(f"\nTotal genes tested: {len(res_subset)}")

sig_subset = res_subset[
    (res_subset["padj"] < 0.05) &
    (res_subset["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
    (res_subset["baseMean"] > 10)
]
n_subset = len(sig_subset)
print(f"\nSignificant DEGs (p<0.05, |log2FC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_subset}")
print(f"  Upregulated (KL > WL): {(sig_subset['log2FoldChange'] > 0).sum()}")
print(f"  Downregulated (KL < WL): {(sig_subset['log2FoldChange'] < 0).sum()}")

# ── Comparison ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n" + "="*70)
print("COMPARISON")
print("="*70)
print(f"Full analysis (KL1-3 vs WL1-3):   {n_full} DEGs")
print(f"Subset analysis (KL1-2 vs WL1-2):  {n_subset} DEGs")
diff = n_subset - n_full
direction = "increase" if diff > 0 else ("decrease" if diff < 0 else "no change")
print(f"Difference (subset - full): {diff:+d}")
print(f"Direction of change: {direction}")

# Save canonical answer
import os
os.makedirs("codex_output", exist_ok=True)
with open("codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(direction + "\n")

print("\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt:", direction)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

# Quick verification: check if LFC shrinkage preserves contrast direction
counts_df = pd.read_csv('inputs/count.csv', index_col=0)
counts = counts_df.T.copy()
metadata = pd.DataFrame({'condition': ['KL','KL','KL','WL','WL','WL']}, index=['KL1','KL2','KL3','WL1','WL2','WL3'])

dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts, metadata=metadata, design='~condition')
dds.deseq2()

stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition', 'KL', 'WL'])
stat.summary()
print('Before shrinkage, first 5 LFCs:')
print(stat.results_df[['log2FoldChange']].head(10))

# Save pre-shrinkage
pre = stat.results_df['log2FoldChange'].copy()

stat.lfc_shrink(coeff='condition[T.WL]')
print('After shrinkage, first 5 LFCs:')
print(stat.results_df[['log2FoldChange']].head(10))

post = stat.results_df['log2FoldChange']

# Check correlation of absolute values
valid = pre.notna() & post.notna()
print(f'Correlation of pre vs post LFC: {pre[valid].corr(post[valid]):.4f}')
print(f'Correlation of pre vs -post LFC: {pre[valid].corr(-post[valid]):.4f}')

# Check a few genes
print()
for g in stat.results_df.index[:5]:
    if pd.notna(pre[g]) and pd.notna(post[g]):
        print(f'{g}: pre={pre[g]:.4f}, post={post[g]:.4f}, -post={-post[g]:.4f}')
" 2>&1 | tail -30
